deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate a pandas DataFrame of crystal structures using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel StructureMatcher comparison
deduplicate_and_remove_duplicates: deduplicate crystal structures in a DataFrame and remove duplicates keeping one representative per group
process_structure_group_clustering: process a pre-filtered group of crystal structures and assign subgroup IDs using greedy clustering with StructureMatcher
review_deduplicate_structures: review the deduplicate_structures function that performs two-stage deduplication with configurable tolerance parameters
refactor_process_structure_group: refactor the process_structure_group function to use a different clustering algorithm instead of greedy matching
